items.hed: Rain Is Also a Working Hour
items.body: Hermetic timing does not require clear skies. The wet Saturday is still a lucida if the inner radar is quiet. Charge and body while the outer storm does its work. Mystics worked the weather that arrived.
Gnostic practice treats unnamed urgency as the real fog. Name the hold: cards frozen, no extra payments until the 23rd. A named boundary is already half kept.
If charge remains after the board, mark it and release. Clean endings keep tomorrow’s opening clean.

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD

breathing.close: Four rounds clears the static. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then the rest of the board.

mindset.body: Dom does not wait for dry radar. Fierce calm is Saturday composure under rain: charge first, body second, security skim when ready, admin only after the morning has already won. Cards stay frozen. One breath, one move, one clear next step. Sunday’s Soldier Field and the 23rd check have a clean operator behind them.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Saturday: run this after Morning Charge — box breathing first, then the body. Rain outside; charge inside. Then news and the day.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom’s RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time. Optional: Front Clips / Back Clips if you want a second RipStick move.
